messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is a first-line treatment used for type 2 diabetes in adults and children 10 years and older to help improve blood sugar levels. It is also used off-label to improve symptoms of polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) and other conditions. Metformin tablets should be used together with dietary changes and exercise for better results.
Metformin belongs to the drug class biguanides.
Metformin works by reducing glucose absorption from the intestines, lowering liver glucose production, and improving insulin sensitivity. Managing blood sugar levels with medications like metformin can prevent diabetes complications such as kidney damage, nerve issues, blindness, amputations, sexual dysfunction, and lower the risk of cardiovascular disease.

The relation 'prevents' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used to prevent the development or progression of the condition or complication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
